name: Worn Parchment
summary: At the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore, Worn Parchment scraps offer clues to the cultists gathered there.

sections.title: Fragments of a Sinister Plot
sections.body: North along Darkshore’s mist-shrouded coast, dark spellcasters and their followers have seized the ruined Tower of Althalaxx. Dark Strand Fanatics patrol the grounds outside and carry scraps of worn parchment among their belongings. One scrap holds only scattered writing and strange symbols. Gathered together, the fragments reveal a previously unknown organization called the Cult of the Dark Strand.

sections.title: Unmasking the Cult
sections.body: From a nearby overlook, scout Balthule Shadowstrike watches the tower and uses the gathered parchments to assess the threat for Delgren the Purifier and the sentinels in Auberdine. The texts confirm that the warlocks there are organized under a cult, not independent outcasts. What the cult plans remains unknown.

faq.answer: Dark Strand Fanatics carry the parchments. They are cultist foot soldiers encamped around the perimeter of the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore.

faq.q: What is written on the parchments?
faq.answer: Each parchment holds cryptic fragments of ritual notes and orders. Gathered and deciphered by Balthule Shadowstrike, they reveal the name and existence of the Cult of the Dark Strand.

faq.q: Why is Balthule Shadowstrike collecting them?
faq.answer: Delgren the Purifier tasked Balthule with watching the Tower of Althalaxx. Balthule needs the writings to learn why warlocks have gathered at the ruins, assess the danger to Darkshore, and report back.

faq.q: What is the Cult of the Dark Strand?
faq.answer: The Cult of the Dark Strand is a secretive gathering of cultists and warlocks based in the ruins of Althalaxx. Even seasoned scouts like Balthule Shadowstrike had never encountered the order before finding these writings.

angles.text: As a warlock, you read of the Dark Strand’s organized coven operating in secret on night elf lands, wielding fel and shadow beyond the gaze of both the Alliance and Horde.
As a night elf, you know dark spellcasters and demonic corruption near ancient ruins like Althalaxx desecrate Darkshore’s sacred wilderness.
